headline: A second war in the Middle East, and a second vital world waterway is about to be blocked
summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have taken control of the historic Yemeni port city of Mocha, according to four military sources. The article describes a second vital world waterway at risk of being blocked.
why: Mocha sits on the Red Sea, and disruption in Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb transit routes affects global shipping, freight rates and energy flows.
